inventory.visualPurpose: Chromosome 15 imprinting: paternal vs maternal silencing
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Paired chromosome-15 diagrams (paternal/maternal) showing imprinted (silenced) genes with deletion/mutation outcomes: paternal deletion → Prader-Willi, maternal UBE3A loss → Angelman

notes: The imprinting figure is an original KYP redraw preserving the source's structure and legend: P (paternal) and M (maternal) chromosome columns, a Normal group where each locus expresses exactly one parent's copy, disease groups where the only active copy carries the deletion/mutation symbol, and the legend P = Paternal, M = Maternal, active gene, silenced gene (imprinting), gene deletion/mutation — plus the source's own POP and MAMAS mnemonic lines. The same-page PWS-vs-AS signs table is accounted under genetic-terms-popgen sv3 (note-block compare).
